rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for people employed by a company or organisation.

example.english: The company hired three new staff.
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 cing2 zo2 saam1 go3 san1 jyun4 gung1

rows.note: Use this for a stick or cane used to help someone walk.

example.english: Grandpa needs a staff to walk.
example.jyutping: je4 je2 haang4 lou6 jiu3 jung6 gwaai2 zoeng6
